tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.market: Dodgers -169 / Brewers +155; total 7.5 (Over +102 / Under -115); run line Brewers +1.5 (-144)
games.our_fair: Dodgers 61.9% / Brewers 38.1% (devigged Pinnacle h2h, power devig); total 7.5: Over 48.6% / Under 51.4%
games.take: The Brewers are two wins from their first World Series in 44 years, up 2-0 after taking both in Milwaukee (2-1, 7-4) — their first-ever 2-0 lead in a best-of-seven. Tonight it's a southpaw duel: Blake Snell (4-1, 1.90 ERA) for the Dodgers against Robert Gasser (5-5, 3.87) for Milwaukee. Snell's stuff is elite but his command wobbled last start (5 walks in 3.2 IP vs Atlanta); Gasser threw four one-run innings against these Dodgers earlier this postseason, and Milwaukee's bullpen has been lockdown all October. The Dodgers are 52-31 at home and desperate — down 0-3 is a death sentence — but the market has this one priced right: our fair line sits within a point of the board everywhere. Weather is a non-issue tonight (clear, mid-70s); note the NWS Heat Advisory for LA starts Thursday morning, which could matter for Games 4-5.
games.title: NLCS Game 3
games.verdict: LEAN: Dodgers -169 — no true edge (fair 61.9% vs 62.8% implied, -1.5% EV), but the lean is the home favorite: the better on-paper starter, the must-win spot, and the number closest to fair. This is an opinion, not a play.

games.matchup: Western Kentucky Hilltoppers @ Sam Houston State Bearkats
games.our_fair: WKU -1.5 covers 47.6% (devigged Pinnacle, power devig); total 52.5: Over 51.0% / Under 49.0%
games.take: WKU finally found its offense last week, beating Missouri State 34-13 with 464 yards — Brock Glenn's dual-threat game (211 pass, 95 rush) plus Ajay Allen's 105 rushing yards gives the Hilltoppers the best unit on the field tonight against a Sam Houston defense allowing 6.0 yards per carry. The Bearkats have scored 17 combined points across their last two FBS games (35-3 loss at Liberty). Injury watch: WKU has four skill players questionable (RBs Baines and Boyd, WRs Hutchinson and Johnson); Sam Houston is without TE Kuhl (out for season). The market number is fair — but one book is dealing WKU +1.5, three full points off the Pinnacle spread, and that's a board play (+2.5% vs our fair). Weather screen clean: no NWS alerts for Huntsville, clear and ~80°F at kickoff.
games.title: Western Kentucky @ Sam Houston State
games.verdict: LEAN: WKU +1.5 — this is a board play (+2.5% vs our fair on the stale soft-book line). Even at the market number, lean the Hilltoppers: the ground game travels, and Sam Houston can't stop the run.

games.our_fair: Over 21.0: 48.6% (devigged Pinnacle, power devig); Over 20.5 ≈ 55.6% including ~7% of outcomes landing exactly on 21 games
games.take: Round of 16 in Wuhan, first career meeting. Sakkari (world No. 35) is in real form — straight-set wins over Donna Vekic and No. 10 Marta Kostyuk (4-6, 6-2, 6-2) this week. Across the net is 17-year-old Slovakian qualifier Mia Pohankova (No. 202), who survived Xiyu Wang in three sets and has been feisty all week. The play here is the number, not the narrative: Pinnacle's fair total is 21.0 and we're getting 20.5, a full game of value with the exactly-21 cluster (7-5 sets, 6-4/4-6/7-5 type three-setters) doing the work. That's a board play at -111 (+3.0% vs our fair). Conditions: outdoor hard, 24°C with light haze — playable, nothing severe.
games.title: Wuhan Open — Round of 16
games.venue: Optics Valley International Tennis Center, Wuhan (Court 1, outdoor hard)
games.verdict: LEAN: Over 20.5 games — board play. The fair total says 21.0; the 20.5 is on the right side of the key number, and both players have gone three sets already this week.

games.matchup: Kennesaw State Owls @ Missouri State Bears
games.our_fair: Kennesaw State 58.5% / Missouri State 41.5% (devigged Pinnacle h2h, power devig); total 52.5 ≈ coin flip (Over 49.7%)
games.take: Two 1-4 teams chasing their first CUSA win, but they're trending opposite directions. Kennesaw State — the defending conference champs — has lost back-to-back heartbreakers by one score (27-26 to Jax State on a last-minute field goal) and just put up 411 yards of offense, the eighth-most in program FBS history, behind dual-threat QB Rickie Collins and WR Brayden Munroe (159 yards last week). Missouri State has dropped three straight, is allowing 32.4 points per game (122nd nationally), and has a live QB question after Skyler Locklear cramped out against WKU and Henry Belin IV finished — the coach says everything is on the table. The market's -3 is fair; there's no edge to bet.
games.title: Kennesaw State @ Missouri State
games.verdict: LEAN: Kennesaw State -3 — no true edge per our fair line (KSU -3 ≈ 49.5% vs 51.0% implied), but the lean is the Owls: the better team, the better form, and Missouri State's quarterback situation is unsettled.
